facts.text: Audrey and Andrew went on a two-hour hike that included stunning views and exploration of nature.

evidence.quote: The hike took us two hours and it was stunning! We saw lots of amazing views and it was great to explore nature.
Nature really refreshes you, right? It's nice to appreciate all the beauty around us.

facts.text: Andrew expressed a desire to spend more time in nature and appreciate it.

evidence.quote: That sounds awesome! Being able to just be in nature and appreciate it is really cool. I wish I could do that more often.

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that hiking is his favorite outdoor activity and that being in nature with trees and fresh air refreshes him.

evidence.quote: Hiking is the best. Being out in nature with all the trees and fresh air always refreshes me.

facts.text: Audrey agreed with Andrew that nature helps to achieve a sense of accomplishment and that worries fade away when in nature.

evidence.quote: Yeah, totally. It's like you've achieved something and all worries just fade away. Nature is pretty special, huh?
